response: A STREET ORGAN IS TUNED USING A SET OF CLETS AND A TUNING TOOL. THE [HELPER NAME] FIRST CHECKS THE ORGAN'S STRUCTURE AND POSITION OF THE KEYS. THEN THEY USE A TUNING TOOL TO MAKE SURE EACH KEY IS PLACED CORRECTLY AND THE [BRUSH WIDTH] IS SET TO A CONSISTENT VALUE. THE [MEETING TIME] IS SET TO ALIGN THE ORGAN WITH THE LOCAL SCHEDULE. THE [MAP SHEET] IS USED TO LOCATE THE ORGAN AND MAKE SURE IT IS PLACED IN THE RIGHT LOCATION.
